contentHtml:
I do not just plug the modem in and leave. I set the whole thing up properly, from picking the right router to sorting the security settings, so your internet works the way it should from day one. Whether you are a small business that needs a fast, stable connection or a family sick of wi-fi dropping out, I can get it right. I cover Stretton and Brisbane's southside, onsite.

Home NBN setup

A proper home install takes the guesswork out of the modem, the wi-fi and getting your devices connected. I place the router where it actually covers the house, set up your NBN-ready modem correctly, kill the black spots with a mesh system or extenders where needed, and get your smart TVs, tablets, PCs and phones all talking to it. No NBN at your address, or stuck on Sky Muster satellite? I can install Starlink as a faster, more reliable alternative.

Business NBN

For a business, a fast and stable connection is not optional, it carries your video calls, cloud apps and point-of-sale. I set up business-grade connections with the reliability you need, including secure wired and wireless networks, network segmentation for better security, device mapping and data transfer, and a static IP where the setup calls for one.

Set up to last, not just switched on

I do more than install. I show you how it works, tune it for coverage and speed, and set it up so it keeps running rather than needing me back next month. If the wi-fi is the main headache, see my wireless home network service, and for anything broader there is network setup.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
